item.title: Ryugado Cave: Kochi's Limestone Wonder — Guide
item.description: Ryugado is counted among Japan’s three great limestone caves, a spectacular cavern carved over a million and a half years into the hills of eastern Kochi. A well-lit walking route of around a kilometre leads through soaring chambers past a wealth of formations — stalactites, flowstone curtains, an underground waterfall and pools — with the added fascination of ancient traces showing that people lived at the cave mouth some two thousand years ago.
